title: MM6 Sea Serpent
description: MM6 olive-gold sea serpent: only the long upright curved neck and broad angular reptile head are visible, truncated at the original waterline, with no added body or water. Rough large olive-gold scales, dorsal row of thin brown triangular spines, pale gray-green segmented belly, broad flattened brow, small eyes and very long curved ivory needle teeth around the open dark mouth. Match native neck bend, head angles and exact teeth placement; no extra fins or redesign.
regions: Olive-gold head/neck scales, brown dorsal crest and pale segmented belly are separate native palette regions; teeth and mouth stay protected.
